note: Hand-derived from CanonicalSecretsIAMUsesServiceAccountEdgeUpsertCypher (go/internal/storage/cypher/cloud/aws/iam/secrets_graph_writer.go): `MATCH (w:KubernetesWorkload {uid: row.workload_uid}) MATCH (s:SecretsIAMServiceAccount {uid: row.service_account_uid}) MERGE (w)-[rel:SECRETS_IAM_USES_SERVICE_ACCOUNT]->(s)`. The static token is baked into the MERGE, so SECRETS_IAM_USES_SERVICE_ACCOUNT is the only type this writer can emit. Each source is the workload_object_id of an exact identity chain and each target is its service_account_join_key: workload-orders-api to sha256:orders-service-account and workload-billing-api to sha256:billing-service-account. Exactly two edges: the fixture's other three chains contribute nothing on purpose -- one partial chain (non-exact state is counted, never promoted), one exact chain with no workload id (missing-workload skip; the ServiceAccount subgraph still projects), and one tombstoned exact chain. The MERGE keys on its two endpoint nodes alone, so there is no identity block; confidence is SET after the MERGE under the exact-only admission contract and is asserted as a mutable property instead.
